record.notes: Version 1.0 is dated 7 Jul 2026 (ROC 115-07-07); MODA's English version carries the same version and date. The framework applies primarily to civilian AI use cases and expressly excludes military uses, which follow national defence laws. Where a sector regulator assesses a use case as high-risk, it must require warnings (Art. 5(2) of the AI Basic Act) and define liability and remedies (Art. 17(1)); where a use case's risks under Art. 5(1) cannot be managed with existing technical means, the regulator must restrict or prohibit it under Art. 16(2). The Ministry will review the list of risk subtypes periodically against new AI risk research and international standards.

record.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Taxonomy and Assessment Framework
record.short_title: Taiwan AI Risk Taxonomy and Assessment Framework
record.summary: Framework made by MODA under Article 16 of the AI Basic Act; sector regulators must follow its workflow when writing risk-based AI rules. It lists 20 risk subtypes in three groups: technical design flaws, such as dangerous capabilities; post-deployment operation and human-AI interaction, such as deepfake fraud, cyberattacks and unauthorized actions by AI agents; and societal-structural and environmental impacts, such as cognitive warfare. Its four steps are use case inventory, risk identification, assessment and response. Use cases that may seriously harm national security, fundamental rights, life and safety, property, social order or the environment are high-risk.

judgment.status_reasoning: The framework is version 1.0, dated 7 Jul 2026 in both the Chinese and the English version. MODA's Chinese page (re-checked unchanged on 18 Oct 2026) and English page (18 Oct 2026; updated 2026-09-17) both present it; the English PDF is version 1.0 of the same date, so the September update of the English page is not a new version. It guides sector regulators, who turn its principles into binding sector rules, so it does not bind anyone outside government itself. Nothing stored shows a later version or a withdrawal. 'Published (non-binding, current)' and 'Non-binding' stand.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published 2026-07-07 is the date on the cover of version 1.0 (中華民國115年7月7日; 'July 7, 2026' on the English version). The page dates (Chinese page updated 2026-07-08; English page created 2026-04-30 and updated 2026-09-17) are web page dates and are not used.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A government risk-classification framework made under Article 16 of Taiwan's AI Basic Act to guide sector regulators' risk-based AI rules; in scope with no note.
judgment.title_reasoning: The official English title is taken from MODA's own English version (cover: 'Artificial Intelligence Risk Taxonomy and Assessment Framework'); the NSTC's translation of Article 16 of the AI Basic Act uses the same term ('AI risk taxonomy and assessment framework'). original_title stays 人工智慧風險分類框架.
